action-bar.note: Ditulis dari kode Kliping: navigasi panah datang dari `RovingFocusGroup` Reka UI di `ActionBarGroup` (mengikuti `orientation`, berputar bila `loop`), Escape dari `ActionBar`.
action-bar.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: arrow navigation comes from Reka UI's `RovingFocusGroup` in `ActionBarGroup` (follows `orientation`, wraps when `loop`), Escape from `ActionBar`.

rows.description: Moves focus into the action group, then to the next focusable element.
Moves focus to the previous focusable element.
Moves focus to the previous or next item when `orientation` is `horizontal`.
Moves focus to the previous or next item when `orientation` is `vertical`.
Moves focus to the first item.
Moves focus to the last item.
Closes the action bar while it is open; emits `escape` first, call `preventDefault()` to keep it open.
Adds one step to the angle.
Subtracts one step from the angle.
Moves ten steps at a time.
Jumps to the minimum.
Jumps to the maximum.

banner.note: Ditulis dari kode Kliping: banner tidak menangani tombol sendiri — tombol di dalamnya (mis. `BannerClose`) memakai perilaku `<button>` bawaan.
banner.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: the banner handles no keys itself — buttons inside it (e.g. `BannerClose`) use native `<button>` behaviour.

rows.description: Moves focus to the next focusable element within the banner.
Moves focus to the previous focusable element.
Activates the focused button, e.g. closes the banner.

checkbox-group.note: Ditulis dari kode Kliping: tiap kotak adalah tombol checkbox Reka UI; navigasi panah hanya aktif bila `rovingFocus` dinyalakan.
checkbox-group.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: each box is a Reka UI checkbox button; arrow navigation is active only when `rovingFocus` is on.

rows.description: Toggles the focused checkbox.
Moves focus to the next checkbox (or into the group when `rovingFocus` is on).
With `rovingFocus`, moves focus between checkboxes along `orientation`.
With `rovingFocus`, moves focus to the first or last checkbox.

color-picker.note: Ditulis dari kode Kliping: popover dan area/penggeser warna adalah primitif Reka UI.
color-picker.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: the popover and the colour area/sliders are Reka UI primitives.

rows.description: On the trigger, opens the picker.
Moves between the area, sliders, inputs, and swatches.
On the area or a slider, nudges the colour.
Closes the picker and returns focus to the trigger.

combobox-advanced.note: Ditulis dari kode Kliping: perilaku keyboard datang dari `ComboboxRoot` Reka UI; badge di mode multiple tidak punya navigasi keyboard sendiri.
combobox-advanced.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: keyboard behaviour comes from Reka UI's `ComboboxRoot`; badges in multiple mode have no keyboard navigation of their own.

rows.description: Opens the list when closed; otherwise highlights the next option.
Highlights the previous option.
When open, highlights the first or last option.
Selects the highlighted option.
Closes the list and returns focus to the input.

compare-slider.note: Ditulis dari kode Kliping: tombol bekerja saat penggeser difokuskan; langkahnya `step` persen.
compare-slider.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: keys work while the slider is focused; one step is `step` percent.

rows.description: Horizontal: moves the divider right by `step`.
Horizontal: moves the divider left by `step`.
Vertical: moves the divider down by `step`.
Vertical: moves the divider up by `step`.
Moves the divider ten steps: PageUp right (horizontal) or up (vertical), PageDown the other way.
Moves the divider ten steps in the arrow's direction.
Moves the divider to 0% (left or top).
Moves the divider to 100% (right or bottom).

cropper.note: Ditulis dari kode Kliping: panah bekerja saat `CropperViewport` difokuskan; penggeser zoom dan rotasi memakai tombol slider Reka UI.
cropper.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: arrows work while `CropperViewport` is focused; the zoom and rotate sliders use Reka UI slider keys.

rows.description: Moves focus to the crop viewport and the controls.
Moves the crop area over the image by 5 px.
Moves the crop area by 20 px.

data-table-advanced.note: Ditulis dari kode Kliping: tidak ada pintasan khusus — menu filter dan urut memakai keyboard menu & popover Reka UI.
data-table-advanced.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: no custom shortcuts — the filter and sort menus use Reka UI menu & popover keys.

editable.note: Ditulis dari kode Kliping: perilaku dari `EditableRoot` Reka UI; bawaannya mengedit saat difokuskan (`activationMode: focus`) dan menyimpan saat blur (`submitMode: blur`).
editable.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: behaviour from Reka UI's `EditableRoot`; by default editing starts on focus (`activationMode: focus`) and saves on blur (`submitMode: blur`).

rows.description: Saves the value when `submitMode` is `enter` or `both`.
Cancels editing and restores the previous value.
Moves focus away; with the default `submitMode: blur` this saves the value.

file-upload.note: Ditulis dari kode Kliping: `FileUploadDropzone` dan tombol bawaan.
file-upload.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: `FileUploadDropzone` and native buttons.

rows.description: On the dropzone or trigger, opens the file dialog.
Moves between the dropzone, trigger, and each file's buttons.

kanban.note: Ditulis dari kode Kliping: sensor keyboard bawaan `dnd-kit-vue`.
kanban.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: the default keyboard sensor of `dnd-kit-vue`.

rows.description: Lifts the focused card or column; press again to drop it.
While lifted, moves it toward the next slot in that direction.
Cancels the move and puts it back.

key-value.note: Ditulis dari kode Kliping: tidak ada pintasan khusus selain tempel; tombol tambah/hapus memakai perilaku `<button>` bawaan.
key-value.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: no custom shortcuts besides paste; the add/remove buttons use native `<button>` behaviour.

rows.description: Moves between key inputs, value inputs, and buttons.
In a key field, pasting multi-line text adds one row per line (when `enablePaste` is on, the default).
Activates the focused add or remove button.

listbox.note: Ditulis dari kode Kliping: perilaku dari `ListboxRoot` Reka UI, panah mengikuti `orientation`.
listbox.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: behaviour from Reka UI's `ListboxRoot`; arrows follow `orientation`.

rows.description: Moves focus into the list, to the selected or first item.
Highlights the previous or next item in a vertical list.
Highlights the previous or next item in a horizontal list.
Highlights the first or last item.
Selects the highlighted item.

marquee.note: Ditulis dari kode Kliping: hanya aktif dengan `pauseOnKeyboard`.
marquee.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: only with `pauseOnKeyboard`.

rows.description: Pauses or resumes the scrolling.

mask-input.note: Ditulis dari kode Kliping: penyuntingannya bawaan `<input>`, lalu nilai dirapikan ulang ke pola mask dan kursor dijaga pada posisi isinya.
mask-input.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: editing is native `<input>` behaviour; the value is then re-masked and the cursor kept at the same content position.

rows.description: Moves focus to or away from the input.
Moves focus to the previous focusable element.
Removes the character before the cursor, then re-applies the mask.
Removes the character after the cursor, then re-applies the mask.
Pastes text; it is cleaned and formatted to the mask.
Selects all input content.

media-player.note: Pintasan bekerja saat pemutar (atau salah satu kendalinya) difokuskan dan `keyboardShortcuts` aktif; penggeser yang sedang difokuskan memakai panahnya sendiri. Ditulis dari kode `MediaPlayer.vue`.

rows.description: Toggles play/pause.
Seeks forward by `seekStep` seconds.
Seeks backward by `seekStep` seconds.
Increases volume by 10%.
Decreases volume by 10%.
Toggles mute.
Toggles fullscreen.
Seeks to the beginning.
Seeks to the end.

media-player.noteEn: Shortcuts work while the player (or one of its controls) has focus and `keyboardShortcuts` is on; a focused slider keeps its own arrow keys. Written from Kliping's `MediaPlayer.vue`.

mention.note: Ditulis dari kode Kliping: tombol navigasi hanya bekerja saat daftar saran terbuka; selain itu tombol bekerja seperti biasa di input.
mention.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: navigation keys only apply while the suggestion list is open; otherwise keys behave as usual in the input.

rows.description: When open, highlights the next suggestion.
When open, highlights the previous suggestion.
When open with a highlighted suggestion, inserts that mention.
When open, closes the suggestion list.

phone-input.note: Ditulis dari kode Kliping: pemilih negara adalah Popover + Command (Reka UI), jadi navigasi daftarnya mengikuti Listbox Reka.
phone-input.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: the country picker is a Popover + Command (Reka UI), so list navigation follows Reka's Listbox.

rows.description: Moves focus between the country button and the phone input.
Opens the country list when the country button is focused.
Filters countries in the search field of the open list.
Moves through countries when the list is open.
Jumps to the first or last country in the list.
Selects the highlighted country.
Closes the country list.

qr-code.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: `QRCodeDownload` is a `<button>`.

rows.description: On the download button, saves the QR code.

rating.note: Ditulis dari kode Kliping: `Rating` dibangun di atas `RatingRoot` Reka UI (pola radio group), jadi fokus dan pilihan bergerak bersama.
rating.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: `Rating` is built on Reka UI's `RatingRoot` (radio group pattern), so focus and selection move together.

rows.description: Moves focus to the selected item, or the first item when none is selected.
Selects the focused item.
Moves focus and selection to the next item.
Moves focus and selection to the previous item.

relative-time-card.note: Ditulis dari kode Kliping: pemicunya `<button>` di atas HoverCard Reka UI — kartu terbuka saat pemicu difokuskan, bukan lewat Enter.
relative-time-card.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: the trigger is a `<button>` on Reka UI's HoverCard — the card opens when the trigger gets focus, not on Enter.

rows.description: Focusing the trigger opens the card; moving focus away closes it.
Closes the open card.

responsive-dialog.note: Ditulis dari kode Kliping: Dialog (layar lebar) dan Drawer (layar sempit), keduanya primitif Reka UI.
responsive-dialog.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: Dialog on wide screens and Drawer on narrow ones, both Reka UI primitives.

rows.description: On the trigger, opens the dialog or drawer.
Cycles focus inside the open dialog.
Closes it and returns focus to the trigger.

segmented-input.note: Ditulis dari kode Kliping: tiap segmen adalah input biasa, jadi perpindahannya urutan fokus bawaan peramban.
segmented-input.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: each segment is a plain input, so moving between them is the browser's normal focus order.

rows.description: Moves focus to the next input in the segment.
Moves focus to the previous input in the segment.

sortable.note: Ditulis dari kode Kliping: sensor keyboard bawaan `dnd-kit-vue`.
sortable.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: the default keyboard sensor of `dnd-kit-vue`.

rows.description: Lifts the focused item; press again to drop it.
While lifted, moves it one position along the list.
Cancels the move and puts it back.

speed-dial.note: Ditulis dari kode Kliping: pemicu dan aksinya tombol biasa; tidak ada penanganan Escape atau penutupan saat fokus keluar.
speed-dial.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: the trigger and actions are plain buttons; there is no Escape handling or closing when focus leaves.

rows.description: When the trigger is focused and `activationMode` is 'click', toggles the speed dial.
Moves focus between the trigger and the actions.
On an action, runs it and closes the speed dial unless `keepOpen` is set.

stepper-advanced.note: Ditulis dari kode Kliping: perilakunya dari `StepperTrigger` Reka UI; panah mengikuti `orientation`, dan `linear` menahan lompatan ke langkah yang belum boleh.
stepper-advanced.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: behaviour comes from Reka UI's `StepperTrigger`; arrows follow `orientation`, and `linear` blocks jumping to steps not yet allowed.

rows.description: Moves focus to the next focusable element.
Moves focus to the previous focusable element.
Activates the focused step, unless it is disabled or blocked by `linear`.
Moves focus to the next step trigger (left/right when horizontal, up/down when vertical).
Moves focus to the previous step trigger (left/right when horizontal, up/down when vertical).

swap.note: Ditulis dari kode Kliping: hanya dengan `activationMode="click"`.
swap.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: only with `activationMode="click"`.

rows.description: Switches between the two states.

tags-input-advanced.note: Ditulis dari kode Kliping: dibangun di atas `TagsInputRoot` Reka UI; tanpa mode sunting tag dan tanpa `addOnTab`.
tags-input-advanced.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: built on Reka UI's `TagsInputRoot`; there is no tag edit mode and no `addOnTab`.

rows.description: When a tag is highlighted, removes it.
When a tag is highlighted, removes it; at the start of an empty input, highlights the last tag.
Highlights the previous tag; at the start of the input, moves to the last tag.
Highlights the next tag; past the last tag, returns to the input.
Highlights the first tag.
Highlights the last tag.
When the input has text, adds it as a tag.
Moves focus out of the input as usual.

time-picker.note: Ditulis dari kode Kliping: field-nya `TimeField` Reka UI (segmen jam, menit, detik, AM/PM); kolom waktu di dalam Popover berisi tombol biasa.
time-picker.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: the field is Reka UI's `TimeField` (hour, minute, second, AM/PM segments); the time columns in the Popover are plain buttons.

rows.description: Types the value of the focused segment and moves on when the segment is complete.
In the period segment, sets AM or PM.
Increments the focused segment.
Decrements the focused segment.
Moves to the next segment.
Moves to the previous segment.
Moves focus to the next or previous segment or control.
Deletes the last digit of the focused segment.
On the trigger, opens or closes the time columns; on a column item, selects that value.
Closes the open time columns.

tour.note: Ditulis dari kode Kliping: pintasan aktif selama tur terbuka, didengarkan di dokumen; fokus tidak dikurung di kartu tur.
tour.noteEn: Written from Kliping's code: shortcuts are active while the tour is open and listen on the document; focus is not trapped in the tour card.

rows.description: Ends the tour when `closeOnEscape` is on (default).
Goes to the next step.
Goes to the previous step.
Activates the focused button (next, previous, skip, or close).
